_comment: The Open/Guarded round rules (systems/combat_rounds.gd, REFERENCE.md §3.7b). Curves are indexed by Combat Skill level 0..5 (index 0 unused). allyBase and the archetype stat bases are the Debug-setup and sim presets. PROSE-REVIEW: every name, intent label and beat line here is new copy.
_moveXpComment: Move levels (REFERENCE §3.7b Move levels): the player's and each contact's per-move XP for the levelled `moves`. resolved / fizzled: XP per use (fizzled: a Stun on a Guarded target, an evaded Strike, a failed Leg it); levels[n] is the cumulative XP that reaches level n (index 0 unused), up to levelMax.
_moveLevelRollComment: A fighter with no persistent move levels (enemies, hired guards, Firm muscle) rolls each move's level once per fight: its Combat Skill level less `below`, at these weights, minimum 1.
_moveLevelEffectsComment: Move-level effects (REFERENCE §3.7b Move levels), read at the acting move's level (Strike, Stun, Leg it: the actor's; Guard: the defender's). Per-level arrays are indexed by level 0..levelMax (index 0 unused). *Level fields are the level an unlock starts at; unlocks are cumulative. Strike: damageBonus is added to the roll before chip; critBonus to the crit chance; chipMultiplier replaces the base chip when the attacker is at chipLevel. Guard: chipMultiplier[level] replaces the base chip; at blockLevel a hit has blockChance to do 0; at firstHitLevel the first hit each round does 0. Stun (the stunner's level): guardedChance[level] to work on a Guarded target; from multiActionLevel a landed Stun takes multiActions of the target's actions instead of params.actions; from openLevel a landed Stun leaves the target Open for openActions of its actions. Feint (the feinter's level): damageBonusPct[level] is the extra % damage a feinted target takes while the opening holds (until it next sets its guard); while its last resolved action was a Feint, a Feint user has autoguardChance[level] to treat one incoming Strike as Guarded, and from retaliateLevel retaliateChance to Strike the attacker back free after a landed hit. Leg it: chance[level]; from keepActionsLevel a failed flee keeps the rest of the actor's actions; from guardedOnFailLevel it leaves the actor Guarded.
_moveBookComment: The Move Book's display strings (systems/move_levels.gd book(), Profile app). Per move: `stat` labels the level track, whose per-level values read moveLevelEffects[move][track.key] (index = level) x track.scale into track.format ({v}); track.zero replaces a 0. `unlocks` are the two milestone cards, at `level` or the moveLevelEffects `levelKey`; `what` is the plain effect, `how` the rule. {name} fills a moveLevelEffects number for that move, {name%} the same x100, {baseChip%} the base chipMultiplier x100, {baseActions} the Stun move's params.actions. `wordRow` (Feint) is a second track row of words, one per level, instead of percentages. PROSE-REVIEW: every string here is new copy.

moveBook.xpLine: {xp} / {next} XP to Lv{level} · +{resolved} per use, +{fizzled} if it fizzles

unlocks.how: Added to your crit chance on every Strike.
Chip damage on a Guarded target rises from {baseChip%}% to {chipMultiplier%}% of the hit.

unlocks.what: {blockChance%}% chance to block a hit outright
unlocks.how: A hit on you while Guarded does 0.

unlocks.what: First hit each round does nothing
unlocks.how: While Guarded, the first hit you take each round does 0.

unlocks.what: Chance to auto-guard against an attack after you Feint
unlocks.how: Greater chance at Lv4, highest at Lv5. An auto-guarded hit only chips.
If your last move was a Feint, {retaliateChance%}% chance to Strike back free when you're hit.

stun.noticeStat: Stun chance on a Guarded target
stun.stat: Chance to stun a Guarded target

unlocks.how: A landed Stun takes the target's next {multiActions} actions instead of {baseActions}.
After your Stun lands, the target is Open for its next {openActions} actions.

unlocks.what: A failed escape keeps your actions
unlocks.how: You don't lose the rest of the round's actions when you don't get away.

unlocks.what: A failed escape leaves you Guarded
unlocks.how: Instead of Open, so the punish hit only chips.

fog._comment: Unread chance per enemy action = (unreadChance[player Combat Skill] + perLevelAbove x levels the enemy is above the player - perLevelBelow x levels below) x positionMultiplier[action index] (last entry for later indices), clamped to [0, 1]. Draft values for tuning.

_sparComment: The calc gym's Spar (systems/sparring.gd, REFERENCE.md §3.7b Spar). unlockFlag opens the gym pin in `district`. freeSessions are used whenever, then each costs `fee` (£, placeholder). xpBase for any result, xpWinBonus on top for a win. rewindRounds is how far the house-rules Rewind goes back. Partners: levelDelta from the player's Combat Skill (clamped to 1..levelMax); stats are the template's before the level bonuses. PROSE-REVIEW: partner names and every line here are new copy.

lines.intro: Flip Reverse. The arch rattles when a train goes over. Mats down, gloves on. Arnie's house rules apply.
lines.houseRules: Arnie's house rules: Rewind is free and there's no limit. When it's over, the gym rewinds you to the start: no bruises, nothing spent.
lines.endRewind: The gym winds you back to the morning. Not a bruise on you, kit all present. The XP stays.
lines.locked: The gym isn't open to you yet.
lines.cantPay: Not enough for the session fee.

_coachComment: Coach marks, shown only when a fight's data carries a `coach` block. hints: one line per move or loadout recipe id; notNow: the block reason for an action the round doesn't allow.

hints.shield: Calc between you and the next hit.
hints.rewind: Go back and do it again.

_tooltipsComment: One pithy line per Fight/Item row, shown in the row's "?" popover. Keyed by move id or loadout recipe id (rewind included).

tooltips.strike: Hit one enemy. Leaves you open.
tooltips.guard: Brace. Hits on you land softer this action.
tooltips.feint: Fake high, hit low. Leaves the enemy open and your guard as it was.
tooltips.stun: Costs a turn off an open enemy. Wasted on one who's braced.
tooltips.timePearl: Stops every enemy for a few actions.
tooltips.blackHole: Drags every enemy in and chips them for it. Higher tiers hold them longer.
tooltips.blast: One enemy takes a bang. Might run, might drop their weapon.
tooltips.shield: A wall of calc between you and the next hit.
tooltips.enhancementPowder: Sniff it. Your actions hit harder for a round or two.
tooltips.prophetsBreath: See what they're about to do, a round or more ahead.
tooltips.beALady: Better odds of a crit, and some hits miss you altogether.
tooltips.panic: One enemy loses their nerve. Might bolt.
tooltips.pansRapture: One enemy stops fighting and stares at nothing.
tooltips.panger: One enemy hits harder for a bit, then softer.
tooltips.pandemonium: One enemy hits softer for a bit, then harder.
tooltips.wormhole: Out. No roll, no parting shot.
tooltips.rewind: Undo the round. Costs a Rewind.

_angerComment: Panger / Pandemonium (REFERENCE §3.7b Table 4): the target's first phaseActions resolved actions deal +X% and take -X%, the next phaseActions the reverse; X = pctPerTier x the unit's tier.
_statusTurnsComment: The turns Panic and Pan's Rapture play in place of an enemy's own actions, as its read intent and the guard state they leave.

chip.self: You hit {target} square on the guard. {dmg} gets through.
chip.other: {actor} hits {target} square on the guard. {dmg} gets through.

feint.self: You feint at {target} and pull the guard open.
feint.other: {actor} feints at {target} and pulls the guard open.

stunThrough.self: You ring {target}'s bell straight through the guard.
stunThrough.other: {actor} rings {target}'s bell straight through the guard.

block.self: You swing at {target}. The guard takes all of it.
block.other: {actor} swings at {target}. The guard takes all of it.

evade.self: You swing at {target} and hit air.

fizzle.self: You try it on. Nothing doing.

fleeFailed.self: You try to leg it. They cut you off.
fleeFailed.other: {actor} tries to leg it and gets cut off.

timePearl.self: You crack a Time Pearl. Everyone else stops.
timePearl.other: {actor} cracks a Time Pearl. Everyone else stops.

blackHole.self: You open a Black Hole. The street leans in.
blackHole.other: {actor} opens a Black Hole. The street leans in.

blast.self: You let a Blast off at {target}. {dmg}, guard or no guard.
blast.other: {actor} lets a Blast off at {target}. {dmg}, guard or no guard.

shield.self: You pop a Shield. The air goes stiff around you.
shield.other: {actor} pops a Shield. The air goes stiff around them.

healSelf.self: You crack a Healing Burst. {amount} back.

heal.self: You crack a Healing Burst over {target}. {amount} back.
heal.other: {actor} cracks a Healing Burst over {target}. {amount} back.

powder.self: You take a pinch of Enhancement Powder. The street slows down.
powder.other: {actor} takes a pinch of Enhancement Powder.

sight.self: You breathe in Prophet's Breath. Their next moves arrive before they do.

sightGiven.self: You breathe in Prophet's Breath. Their next moves arrive before they do.
sightGiven.other: {actor} holds a Prophet's Breath under your nose. Their next moves arrive before they do.

failsafe.self: Your Failsafe fires. Back up on 1 HP.
failsafe.other: {actor}'s Failsafe fires. Back up on 1 HP.

lady.self: You crack Be a Lady. Luck takes your arm.
lady.other: {actor} cracks Be a Lady. Luck takes their arm.

rapture.other: {actor} hands {target} the rapture. They take it gladly.

wormhole.other: {actor} folds the space shut and is gone.

autoguard.other: {actor} Feinted last, so their guard comes up on its own as {target} swings.
